crime: At dinner, the girls talked about what they would do after leaving the prison. {WITCH_NAME} always said, “Nothing.” One girl made a game of guessing for her. One evening the guess was the exact wish of the prisoner beside her, and everyone agreed: “That's so you.”

{WITCH_NAME} invited the girl to the flower field at dusk to see what she really loved. At its far edge, she took the girl's hand, put her to sleep, and laid her in the deep grass. She returned before lockup and said the girl had stayed outside to watch the stars.

The guards searched through the night. At dawn they found the girl dead from the cold, her hands open and the grass beneath her undisturbed. There were no drugs in her body. She had never stirred as the night grew colder. The last person seen holding her hand was {WITCH_NAME}, whose touch could keep a sleeper from waking.
fields.epitaph: No one heard a wish that was hers.
fields.epithet: A Wish Answered by Everyone Else
execution: A moving floor led toward an open door and a small, lit room. As she walked toward it, the floor ran backward at her walking pace. The door stayed out of reach. When her legs gave out, the floor carried her over its rear edge into the darkness below. There was one impact, then silence.

magic.name: Lullaby
magic.text: With a touch, she can put someone into an unbreakable sleep.
